name: client-16c
description: Hypothetical client-SoC NPU sized from Apple's published M4 figures (16-core Neural Engine, 38 TOP/s, 120 GB/s): 16 cores of 32x32 output-stationary arrays at 1.2 GHz (39.32 TOP/s), 100 B/cycle DRAM shared with the CPU and GPU. Per core: SRAM 256 KiB, one 256-bit AXI port, Vela 5.2.0 Ethos_U85_SYS_DRAM_High latencies and outstanding limits, depthwise datapath 128 MAC/cycle. Derivation: docs/design-points.md, section 4.
